Historically, the Dai Thanh Gate has been intertwined with the thousand-year legacy of Vietnamese scholarship, its very name “Đại Thành” derived from the phrase “Khổng Tử tập đại thành,” honoring Confucius as the great synthesizer of human wisdom. This symbolic naming underscores the gate’s role as a portal to the heart of the Temple of Literature, where the spirit of learning and academic excellence is celebrated.
